candidates.description: This vector represents Thai consonant clusters, syllables, and common character combinations found in Thai script.
This feature vector is sensitive to the Thai consonant 'ส' (So Suea) appearing at the end of syllables or words, as well as preceding vowel and tone mark combinations.
These tokens are Thai consonantal clusters and syllable initials commonly found in Thai script.
This feature vector detects common English acronyms, abbreviations, and mixed-script character sequences.
This vector represents biological testing, viral diagnostics, and related laboratory terminology involving PCR and RNA.
This feature vector represents common Thai script characters, sub-word components, and unrelated noise tokens that activate a shared attention mechanism.
This feature vector activates on Thai script characters, specific Thai words, and English loan words or fragments often associated with bilingual text processing.
This feature vector represents common Thai script fragments, punctuation, and mixed-language subwords indicative of multilingual tokenization artifacts.
This feature vector activates on a mixed-script collection of Thai text fragments and English subwords.
This feature activates for the Thai consonant 'ผ' and character sequences containing it.
